frames_match_plan.rule: Every frame of PLAN_TH §8 (plus the 6 Thai variants) exists once, on its page, at its size.

no_dangling_links.rule: Every prototype link and every flow start points at an existing top-level frame.

all_hotspots_wired.rule: No SVG hotspot layer is left without a destination.

reachable_from_N00.rule: Every frame can be reached from N00-flow-map by clicking prototype links.

no_dead_ends.rule: Every frame has at least one outgoing link.

route_table_edges.rule: Each "entry → frame" and "frame → destination" pair of the route table exists as a link.

no_conflicting_hotspots.rule: No two click targets with different destinations overlap at all.

hotspots_inside_frame.rule: Every click target lies inside its frame.

text_inside_frame.rule: No text box crosses the edge of its frame.

children_inside_parent.rule: Every layer lies inside its frame and inside the group that holds it.

markers_present.rule: Every frame carries the "NEAR testnet" marker chip; NC-04 says "concept"; cross-chain previews say "Mainnet preview · not executed".

language_separation.rule: English frames contain no Thai except the "ไทย" switch; -th frames are in Thai.

no_embedded_images.rule: The document embeds no bitmap: every mark is our own vector or text.
